meta.name: firebase-basics
meta.description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

copy.tagline: 快速配置 Firebase CLI 并切换项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚开始接入 Firebase 或需要切换项目环境
copy.tagline_en: Quickly set up Firebase CLI and switch between projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up Firebase CLI or manage Firebase projects from scratch

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你安装和检查 Firebase CLI 版本、登录、创建或切换项目，以及下载安卓和 iOS 的配置文件（google-services.json 和 GoogleService-Info.plist）。它不处理托管、数据库等其他 Firebase 服务。
howto.when: 当你需要进行 Firebase CLI 初始设置（安装、登录），或者创建/选择项目，或者需要下载安卓/ iOS 的配置文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 Firebase CLI 是否安装并查看版本。
say.note: Claude 会运行版本检查命令。

say.text: 创建一个名为 my-app 的新 Firebase 项目。
say.note: Claude 会引导你创建并设置项目。

say.text: 帮我下载安卓项目的 google-services.json。
say.note: Claude 会通过 CLI 获取配置文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you install and check the Firebase CLI version, log in, create or switch projects, and download Android and iOS config files (google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist). It does not handle other Firebase services like hosting, database, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Firebase CLI initial setup (installation, login), project creation/switching, or downloading Android/iOS config files.

say_en.text: Check if Firebase CLI is installed and show the version.
say_en.note: Claude runs the version check command.

say_en.text: Create a new Firebase project named my-app.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to create and set up the project.

say_en.text: Download google-services.json for my Android project.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the config via CLI.
